content.comment_body: Hello, I seem to have found a possible bug in [product_name] [version_no]. When opening a project created in a previous version ([version_no]), the copy and paste shortcuts (CTRL C and CTRL V) don't function correctly. Specifically, after trying to copy a text label in such a migrated project, the copy command seems to stop working entirely. However, copy-paste works as intended in projects made directly in [version_no].
It appears to be a bug in [product_name] [version_no].

Hi [user_name], you're not the only one experiencing copy-paste issues in [product_name] [version_no]. Several other users, including myself, have encountered the same problem. It seems to be a significant issue that the [company_name] development team hasn't addressed publicly yet. Regards, [user_name] (message translated with Google)

Hopefully, the [company_name] team will resolve the issue soon. Additionally, the font size in the file dialog of the new [product_name] [version_no] is quite small, making it difficult to read. It would be helpful to have options to adjust font and UI text sizes.
Updating to [product_name] [version_no] seems to address many issues. Please install the latest updates for both software and firmware. You can download the update here: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users have reported a major bug affecting copy-paste functionality (CTRL C/CTRL V) in projects migrated from a previous [product_name] version to the latest. The issue prevents copy-paste from working in these migrated projects, while it performs normally in projects created in the new version. Concerns were also raised about UI font sizes, indicating both functional and usability challenges in the updated release.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect smooth backward compatibility so copy-paste works reliably with older projects in the new software version. They also want greater control over UI font size for improved readability and accessibility.
